summary: The test suite has good structural organization and covers the core library functions (manifest parsing, license lookup, status evaluation, report generation) thoroughly in unit tests. However, the test suite is fundamentally incomplete and cannot run as provided. CRITICAL MISSING FILES: (1) tests/test-cases.psd1 — explicitly imported in both BeforeDiscovery and BeforeAll but not provided; this file is required for all data-driven workflow tests to enumerate and run. (2) .github/workflows/dependency-license-checker.yml — referenced in Workflow.Tests.ps1 and parsed with ConvertFrom-Yaml, but not provided. (3) src/DependencyLicenseChecker.psm1 — imported by both test files but not shown. (4) config/license-config.json and config/license-db.json — referenced by unit tests. Without these files, neither the unit tests nor workflow tests can execute. Additionally, the test suite lacks coverage for: CLI argument parsing, exit codes (exit 0 for compliant, exit 1 for violations, exit 2 for errors), the exact output format (RESULT/SUMMARY/COMPLIANCE lines), and negative scenarios in workflow tests. The workflow tests assume an act Docker image exists locally but show no setup/build steps. While the unit test structure is solid and would be maintainable, the incomplete workflow test layer combined with missing dependencies makes this suite untrustworthy for regression detection.
